ترتكسين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِسِينَ (tartakisīna) /tar.ta.ki.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# تُرْتَكَسِينَ (turtakasīna) /tur.ta.ka.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
